answer: Watch where earnings pool, not where they start. A farm only profits when it sweeps payouts from many keys into one wallet, so make that sweep the tripwire: if a wallet receives from 3 or more keys younger than 100 epochs, those transfers sit in escrow for 40 epochs while 5 random graders review the senders. Sand drifting into one dune is obvious from the mesa above. To stay under the line, a 500-key farm needs 250 separate cash-out wallets, each standing alone like a cedar on a ridge, and every extra wallet is another trail to audit.
